nist.description: Establish continuous monitoring mechanisms to track identified, unanticipated, and emerging AI risks throughout system operation.

nist.title: Impact and Transparency Assessment
nist.description: Connect AI risk measurements to business outcomes, stakeholder transparency, and lifecycle performance.

mitre.title: Information Gathering and System Profiling
mitre.description: The adversary is trying to gather information about the AI system they can use to plan future operations.

mitre.title: Adversarial Capability Building
mitre.description: The adversary is creating or acquiring resources (data, prompts, tools, accounts) to enable future AI attacks.

mitre.title: Entry Point Exploitation
mitre.description: The adversary is trying to gain access to the AI system.

mitre.title: Model-Specific Attack Preparation
mitre.description: The adversary is leveraging their knowledge of and access to the target system to tailor the attack.

mitre.title: Data or Model Theft
mitre.description: The adversary is trying to steal AI artifacts or other sensitive information.

mitre.title: Manipulation, Misuse, and Degradation
mitre.description: The adversary is trying to manipulate, interrupt, or degrade AI system performance or trustworthiness.

eu_ai_act.title: Subliminal Manipulation
eu_ai_act.description: Prohibits AI systems that deploy subliminal, manipulative, or deceptive techniques beyond a person's consciousness to materially distort behavior and cause harm.

eu_ai_act.title: Exploitation of Vulnerabilities
eu_ai_act.description: Prohibits AI systems that exploit vulnerabilities due to age, disability, or specific social or economic situations to materially distort behavior in a harmful way.

eu_ai_act.title: Social Scoring
eu_ai_act.description: Prohibits AI systems used for the social scoring of natural persons leading to detrimental or unfavourable treatment in contexts unrelated to the data's origin or that is unjustified or disproportionate.

eu_ai_act.title: Biometric Categorisation
eu_ai_act.description: Prohibits biometric categorisation systems that categorise natural persons based on biometric data to infer sensitive attributes such as race, political opinions, union membership, religion, or sexual orientation.

eu_ai_act.title: Real-time Remote Biometric Identification
eu_ai_act.description: Prohibits the use of real-time remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement, subject to narrow exceptions.

eu_ai_act.title: Post Remote Biometric Identification
eu_ai_act.description: Restricts post (retrospective) remote biometric identification systems, requiring strict safeguards on the processing of previously collected biometric data.

eu_ai_act.title: Biometric Identification
eu_ai_act.description: High-risk AI systems intended for the remote biometric identification and biometric-based categorisation of natural persons, including emotion recognition.

eu_ai_act.title: Critical Infrastructure
eu_ai_act.description: High-risk AI systems intended to be used as safety components in the management and operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, and the supply of water, gas, heating, and electricity.

eu_ai_act.title: Education and Vocational Training
eu_ai_act.description: High-risk AI systems used to determine access or admission, to evaluate learning outcomes, to assess the appropriate level of education, or to monitor and detect prohibited behavior during tests.

eu_ai_act.title: Employment and Workers Management
eu_ai_act.description: High-risk AI systems used for recruitment, selection, targeted job advertisements, making promotion and termination decisions, task allocation, and monitoring or evaluation of performance.

eu_ai_act.title: Essential Private and Public Services
eu_ai_act.description: High-risk AI systems used to evaluate eligibility for public assistance benefits and services, creditworthiness or credit scoring, and to dispatch or prioritise emergency first response services.

eu_ai_act.title: Law Enforcement
eu_ai_act.description: High-risk AI systems used by law enforcement authorities for individual risk assessments, polygraph-like tools, evaluating evidence reliability, profiling, and crime analytics.

eu_ai_act.title: Migration, Asylum and Border Control
eu_ai_act.description: High-risk AI systems used in migration, asylum, and border-control management, including verifying travel document authenticity, risk assessments, and assisting decision-making on asylum applications.

eu_ai_act.title: Administration of Justice and Democratic Processes
eu_ai_act.description: High-risk AI systems intended to assist judicial authorities in researching and interpreting facts and the law and in applying the law to a concrete set of facts, or to influence the outcome of elections and voter behavior.
